Its Internal Quality Checks row 25 still mentions retired reward.toml; the current Quality Checks row 25 and staged skill explicitly govern scoring.toml here. Frozen task tests/scoring.toml:1-11 contains exactly render/constraints gates at 0, functional/polish/visual weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, and functional floor 0.05. Actual Python 3.12 tomllib assertions found exactly the five expected suite/dimension paths and confirmed valid judge keys/types, fallback claude-code, batched mode, isolated=false, positive nested timeouts, correct all_pass/weighted_mean aggregation, no prohibited model/reasoning_effort/temperature/judge-weight keys, unique nonempty criterion IDs/names, positive finite weights and nonempty descriptions. All five judge blocks match their frozen template blocks exactly. Each judge.toml:6 points to an existing prompt.md with exactly one {criteria} and one {app_context}; actual context substitution succeeded for every prompt, and all Functional criterion Sxx references resolve to a scenario heading. Every judge.toml:8-12 declares the canonical Playwright stdio server; only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 adds verifier with /usr/local/bin/python3 and ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER']. tests/test.sh:127-193 generates, substitutes, chmods and exports that helper before context injection at 195-201 and the gates/scored calls at 213/224, each followed by score.py at 217/227. Functional prompt.md:23,427,432 confines restart_app to the single shared S22 restart. tests/tools/restart_mcp.py reads the helper argument, advertises restart_app, uses a single-use marker and invokes the helper with a sanitized environment. scoring.toml, test.sh, Dockerfile and both shared tools are byte-identical to the frozen template. A conforming alternative using server-rendered library records and an opaque/second-loopback preview is explicitly allowed by constraints/judge.toml:27 and Functional prompt.md:13; no structural false-failure path was identified. These are source counterexample analyses, not measured app scores. All 84 task/rule manifest hashes matched.
